title: New home - 10 minutes to Broadway/12th South
description:
This is a new build in Woodbine, TN. It's a 10 minute drive to downtown, East Nashville, 12th South and all the other hot neighborhoods in town. This is my house full time, so you'll be staying in a cozy environment with clean decor.

The space
Beautiful, spacious house that I call my own home. I take pride in it, so you will feel very at home in this home less than 10 minutes from Broadway.

Guest access
You will have free reign throughout the house. The master bedroom will be locked for personal use.

Other things to note
There is a private driveway, so feel free to bring a car.
